newsitem.title: FRANCE: Promodes denies Casino bid rumour.
newsitem.headline: Promodes denies Casino bid rumour.

text.p: A spokesman for retailer Promodes on Friday denied his company was preparing a bid for Casino, a rumour which had boosted the Casino share and dragged Promodes down.
Casino was up 3.21 percent at 257 francs at 1227 GMT and Promodes was down 2.73 percent at 1,921.

Dealers said the rumour stemmed from the publication in the Balo official bulletin of the items for Promodes' shareholders meeting which includes an authorisation for an increase of the share capital.
The spokesman, denying the company had prepared a bid on Casino or would be in talks with the retailer, said that every year authority was sought for an increase in capital.
"Each year, this announcement is made in the Balo. That does not mean that we will do it," he said.
